boundaries.name: proof-gadget-and-dummy-verification
boundaries.obligation: add_proof_target_and_conditionally_verify (utils::recursively_verifiable / dummy::conditionally_verify_proof) must actually verify the active proof under the fixed real branch VD and the inactive proofs under the fixed dummy VD; recursive verifier soundness and dummy-proof existence for every branch common data are not proved here.

boundaries.name: field-boolean-and-select-lowering
boundaries.obligation: Derive ModularSelectorGates from the actual safe Boolean gadget, add/assert_one gates, BuilderLogic::select_vec (utils::logic) four-product sum and connect gates; the model asserts that arithmetic on integer representatives and proves the bridge only from those premises.

boundaries.name: balance-public-input-parsing-and-genesis-values
boundaries.obligation: from_pis/from_u64_slice/to_vec/new(checked) are modeled in Zkp.Implementation.BalancePublicInputs; their refinement of balance_pis.rs, the empty-tree roots, PrivateState::new and the Poseidon commitment (GenesisEnvironment.hashInputs) are separate obligations. Inactive-branch candidates are parsed without range checks.

boundaries.name: carried-verifier-data-and-cyclic-key
boundaries.obligation: Only the genesis candidate uses the virtual balance VD; non-genesis candidates carry the VD found in their own proof public inputs and nothing in this file connects either to the independently supplied balance_vd. The outer BalanceCircuit cyclic-key check and the virtual VD target's freedom for genesis proofs are external obligations.

boundaries.name: native-witness-proving-and-cap-count
boundaries.obligation: PartialWitness writes, HashMap lookups, CircuitData::prove and native VerifierCircuitData::verify are opaque with preserved order and error categories. Native decoding uses the prove-time balance_vd.common.config cap height while the circuit uses the constructor balance_config; the model uses one shared capCount.

boundaries.name: serialization-and-deserialized-consistency
boundaries.obligation: bincode/serde/AllGateSerializer/proof byte codecs are opaque callbacks; only call order, short-circuit and the dummy-index dispatch are modeled. from_bytes performs no consistency check between payload target/public_inputs and the decoded circuit data, and HashMap duplicate-index overwrite is not modeled.

boundaries.name: tests-and-fund-safety-scope
boundaries.obligation: The cfg(test) module is read but not mapped to production constraints. Branch acceptance implies nothing about conservation of money, spend validity (SendTx), L1 finality or channel authorization; KeyTrace is a provenance abstraction, not a source translation.
